_about: Public-domain Richard Mant (1776-1848), Bishop of Down and Connor, for the Word Hoard: An Appeal to the Gospel (his Bampton Lectures), Sermons for Parochial and Domestic Use, Two Tracts on Regeneration and Conversion, The Order for the Visitation of the Sick, his metrical Book of Psalms, Biographical Notices of the Apostles, The Clergyman's Obligations Considered, The Gospel Miracles, The Happiness of the Blessed. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 138 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mant-visitation-sick: The Order for the Visitation of the Sick, from the Book of Common Prayer; Interspersed with (printed for F.C. and J . Rivington, 1807)
mant-appeal-gospel: An appeal to the Gospel, or, An inquiry into the justice of the charge alleged by the Methodists and other objectors that the Gospel is not preached by the national clergy : in a series of discourses delivered before the University of Oxford in the year 1812 (Oxford : University Press, 1812)
mant-sermons-1: Sermons, for parochial and domestic use, designed to illustrate and enforce (Printed for J. Parker , and C. and J . Rivengton, London, by W. Baxter, 1823, 1813)
mant-two-tracts: Two tracts, intended to convey correct notions of regeneration and conversion, according to the sense of Holy Scripture, and of the Church of England : extracted from the Bampton lecture of 1812 (London : Printed for F.C. and J. Rivington, 1815)
mant-psalms: The Book of Psalms, in an English metrical version : founded on the basis of the authorized Bible translation, and compared with the original Hebrew ; with notes critical and illustrative (Oxford : Printed by W. Baxter for J. Parker [etc.], 1824)
mant-apostles: Biographical notices of the apostles, evangelists, and other saints (Oxford, 1828)
mant-clergymans-obligations: The clergyman's obligations considered: with particular reference to the ordination vow (catalogued 1830)
mant-gospel-miracles: The Gospel Miracles: with illustrative conversations (Printed for J. G. & F . Rivington, 1832)
mant-happiness-blessed: The happiness of the blessed : considered as to the particulars of their state: their recognition of each other in that state; and its difference of degrees. To which are added, Musings on the church and her services (Philadelphia : Key & Biddle, 1833)

_excluded.mant-bible: the D'Oyly and Mant Bible is a commentary compiled jointly with George D'Oyly (many-author)
_excluded.mant-warton: his edition of Thomas Warton's Poetical Works and his verses on Joseph Warton are literary
_excluded.mant-school: the parsing of Corderius is a school book
_excluded.mant-others: An Inquiry into the Effect of Baptism is John Scott's
_excluded.mant-dups: the 1813 Appeal and the DLI copies of the Sermons
